settings.heading: 500D nylon cordura
settings.content:
Made from high tenacity nylon 6,6 Cordura yarn, this fabric is incredibly strong. Much lighter and with a finer weave than the 1000D equivalent, the 500D is still highly tear-resistant and abrasion resistant.

Bags that use this fabric: Goose (Large), Savoury Jug (Small)

settings.heading: compression system
settings.content:
Designed to secure a complete deck as well as a spare deck. The side compression straps wrap under the front sleeve to securely hold a spare deck. The straps and back side of the sleeve are made from a super tough hypalon material, which not only protects bag from the grip tape and the board edges, but also provided grip to the board from slipping.

Bags that use this fabric: Goose (Large), Savoury Jug (Small)

settings.heading: FD Crimped Poly
settings.content:
A lightweight technical fabric originally developed for the South Korean military, the FD Crimped Poly is soft to the touch, with a very matte texture, and is extremely water-resistant. The crimped yarn increases its abrasion resistance and also gives the fabric a small amount of mechanical stretch.

Products that reference this: Golden Sample - Pants
